title: 第14章 老者受伤了第15章 拜师
slug: 剑里乾坤第3107章不似作伪
content_zh:
不一会时间，翠姐和高碧柔就把饭菜端到桌子上面了，卓然拉着老者来到房间，高碧柔连忙把老者让到上座，高碧柔问道“老人家！您要不要喝点酒呀？”老者呵呵大笑说道“老夫是无酒不下饭的！”高碧柔其实是不希望老者喝酒的，毕竟老者年龄大了，又是独自一个人，所以还是有点担心的！但是现在老者已经说了无酒不下饭这样的话，她只好把酒拿了出来，小卓然抱着酒坛就给老者倒了一碗酒！老者呵呵一笑说道“卓然这孩子很是聪明呀！”
老者也没多喝，一共喝了三杯，他就开始吃饭了，这样倒是让高碧柔放心不少，吃饭的时候，卓然不停的把菜夹给老者碗里，高碧柔也是很热情，很快吃完午饭。卓然下午还要去学堂上学，老者也感谢高碧柔的招待，一老一小就向门外走去，高碧柔站在厨房门口，目送他们两人离开，就在这时老者突然身子一歪，嘴里哎呀一声，整个人倒在地上，高碧柔连忙跑向老者，卓然也连忙转身去扶老者，嘴里还问道“老爷爷！您怎么了？”高碧柔这时也来到老者身边，她也弯下腰，想要和卓然一起把老者扶起来，但是他们力量太小根本就扶不起来，高碧柔连忙喊翠姐过来帮忙，三人这才把老者扶到房间里面，老者很不好意思的说道“脚扭伤了疼的厉害！暂时不能动了！”高碧柔连忙说道“老人家！您先别乱动，我们帮您先扶到配房的床上躺一会！”高碧柔对卓然说道“然儿你先去学堂上学，这里的事情妈妈和你翠姨处理！”卓然看了一眼老者，然后转身就去学堂了！
高碧柔这时问道“老人家！您在这躺一会，我去给您找个郎中过来看看！”老者闻言连忙说道“不用那么麻烦了，我只是扭了一下而已，找郎中来也不起作用！”我先休息一下，待会再看看吧！”高碧柔接着又说道“老人家！您家住什么地方？”老者闻言一阵唏嘘说道“我就一个人，四海为家！”这个回答出乎高碧柔的意料，她看了一下翠姐以后对老者说道“老人家！您先躺一会，我们先出去！有事您喊我们就可以了！”说完她们两人转身就出去了，在把门关上的那一刻，老者脸上露出狡黠的笑容，原来这老者并没扭伤，他只是看卓然很聪明伶俐，又很懂事，人品又很善良，就想找个理由留下来，指导一下卓然。
高碧柔和翠姐来到院子里面以后，翠姐说道“这老人家现在受伤动不了，这可怎么办呀？”高碧柔微微一笑说道“老人家既然四海为家，就让他住在这里养伤呗！等老人家伤好了再说吧！”她们两人虽然说话声音很小，但是房间里面的老者可是听的一清二楚，他可是十丈之内落叶之声都能听见的武林高手！他笑着点了点头。心里也更加肯定这对母子了！这时外面的翠姐说道“你呀！就是心太善了，这不是拣了一个爹回来了吗？”高碧柔说道“翠姐！你看老人家一个人多不容易呀？现在又受伤了！住在这里先养好伤再说！”翠姐点了点头说道“现在只能这样了！”
下午，卓然下学回来以后，他先放下书包，然后就问高碧柔“娘！老爷爷怎么样了？”高碧柔看着卓然说道“老爷爷脚扭伤了，没有大问题，躺几天就好了，他现在正在配房里面躺着了！你现在可以过去看看老爷爷，然后把先生布置的作业完成！”卓然一蹦一跳的来到老者的房间，见老爷爷躺在床上，他说道“老爷爷！您的脚现在还疼吗？”老者说道“小家伙！放学了？疼还是疼的，不动就好多了！”卓然又说道“老爷爷您要不要喝点水？”老者笑着说道“小家伙！我没事，你赶紧去把先生布置的作业完成了，你也可以拿到我这里来写，我也看看你们先生都教你们什么了？”
卓然点了点头，然后就跑到房间，把自己的书包拿到老者的房间，他掏出文房四宝，认真的写着《千字文》，老者看着卓然写的字，不由连连点头！卓然有写的不规矩的，他不时的提醒卓然，很快卓然就写完了先生布置的作业！老者呵呵一笑说道“你的字写的很端正，很好！你们先生一定表扬你了吧？”卓然骄傲的说道“先生每次都表扬我，说我天资聪颖，让我要坚持下去！”老者说道“卓然！你是个好孩子，男子汉！想不想多帮妈妈做点事情，以后长大了保护妈妈？”卓然听完老者这话以后，立刻站了起来说道“我一定要保护妈妈的！”老者伸出手摸了摸卓然的额头说道“老爷爷教你一个方法，让你变得更有力气，以后保护妈妈好不好呀？”卓然很用力的点了点头说道“好！”
外面响起了一阵马蹄声，卓然对老者说道“蔡爷爷回来了，不知道今天带什么给我吃了！我去看看拿好吃的给您吃！”老者说道“去吧！”卓然跑到门口，果然是老蔡赶着马车到门口了，卓然连忙把大门全部打开，让马车可以直接来到院子里面，老蔡把马车停好，他下了马车先是摸了摸卓然的小脸说道“卓然，有没有想我呀？”卓然连连点头说道“想了！想了！”老蔡呵呵一笑说道“想我带什么好吃的给你是真的吧？”说完他从马车里面，拿出一包点心递给了卓然，然后他就把马车卸了下来！卓然则拿着那包点心向西侧配房跑了过去，老蔡看了一眼，虽然有点吃惊，因为他知道那个房间一直都是空着的，平时很少有人去，但是也没问什么！就在这时高碧柔从厨房出来，走到他身边，把老者受伤的事情告诉了他！老蔡闻言连忙也走到老者房间，他一进房间就问道“老哥！您脚不碍事吧？”老者闻言连忙说道“不碍事！就是扭了一下，过几天就好了！倒是给你们添麻烦了！”老蔡说道“没事就好！您尽管放心在这里养伤，别的您不用管！”老者连连点头说道“给你们添麻烦了！”老蔡说道“没事，不麻烦！你先休息，我出去忙一会！”说完他转身就出去了！

After a while, Sister Cui and Gao Birou brought the food to the table. Zhuo Ran took the old man to the room. Gao Birou quickly asked the old man to take the seat. Gao Birou asked, "Old man! Do you want a drink?" The old man laughed and said, "I can't eat without wine!" Gao Birou actually didn't want the old man to drink. After all, the old man was old and alone, so he was still a little worried! But now that the old man had said that there would be no food without wine, she had no choice but to take out the wine. Xiao Zhuoran held the wine jar and poured a bowl of wine for the old man! The old man chuckled and said, "This kid Zhuoran is very smart!"
The old man didn't drink much. After drinking three glasses in total, he started to eat. This made Gao Birou feel relieved. During the meal, Zhuo Ran kept putting vegetables into the old man's bowl. Gao Birou was also very enthusiastic and finished his lunch quickly. Zhuo Ran had to go to school in the afternoon. The old man also thanked Gao Birou for the hospitality. The old man and the young boy walked out the door. Gao Birou stood at the door of the kitchen and watched the two of them leave. At this moment, the old man suddenly tilted his body and let out an oops, and his whole body collapsed. On the ground, Gao Birou quickly ran to the old man, and Zhuo Ran quickly turned around to help the old man, and asked, "Grandpa! What's wrong with you?" Gao Birou came to the old man at this time, and she also bent down, trying to help the old man up with Zhuo Ran, but he They were too weak to help him up. Gao Birou quickly called Sister Cui to come and help. The three of them helped the old man into the room. The old man said embarrassedly, "My ankle is sprained and it hurts so much! I can't move for the time being!" Gao Birou quickly said, "Old man Home! Don't move around. We'll help you lie down on the bed in the side room for a while!" Gao Birou said to Zhuoran, "Ran'er, you go to school first. Mom will handle the matter here with your Aunt Cui!" Zhuoran glanced at the old man, then turned and went to the school!
Gao Birou asked at this time, "Old man! You lie here for a while, and I will find a doctor for you to come and take a look!" The old man heard the words and said quickly, "Don't bother, I just twisted it, and calling a doctor will not work!" I will take a rest first, and we will take a look later! Gao Birou then said, "Old man!" Where do you live? The old man sighed after hearing this and said, "I am just one person, and my home is all over the world!" "This answer was beyond Gao Birou's expectation. She looked at Sister Cui and then said to the old man, "Old man! You lie down for a while, and we'll go out first! If anything happens, just call us! "After that, the two of them turned around and went out. The moment they closed the door, a sly smile appeared on the old man's face. It turned out that the old man was not sprained. He just saw that Zhuo Ran was smart, sensible, and kind, so he wanted to find a reason to stay and guide Zhuo Ran.
After Gao Birou and Sister Cui came to the yard, Sister Cui said, "This old man is injured and can't move now. What should we do? Gao Birou smiled slightly and said, "Since the old man has a home all over the world, let him live here to recuperate!" Let’s wait until the old man recovers from his injury! "Although the two of them spoke very quietly, the old man in the room heard them clearly. He was a martial arts master who could hear the sound of falling leaves within ten feet! He smiled and nodded. He was even more convinced about the mother and son! At this time, Sister Cui outside said, "You! His heart is too kind, isn't he just choosing a father to come back to? Gao Birou said, "Sister Cui!" Do you think it's hard for an old man to be alone? Now I'm injured again! Stay here and heal your injuries first! Sister Cui nodded and said, "This is the only thing we can do now!" "
In the afternoon, after Zhuo Ran came back from school, he first put down his schoolbag, and then asked Gao Birou, "Mom! How is grandpa? Gao Birou looked at Zhuoran and said, "Grandpa sprained his foot. It's not a big problem. He will be fine just lying down for a few days. He is lying down in the side room now!" You can go over now and have a lookGrandpa, then complete the homework assigned by your husband! "Zhuoran jumped up and down to the old man's room. When he saw the old man lying on the bed, he said, "Grandpa! Do your feet still hurt? "The old man said, "Little guy! School is over? It still hurts, but it gets better if you don't move! Zhuoran said again, "Grandpa, would you like some water?" The old man smiled and said, "Little guy!" I'm fine. You hurry up and finish the homework assigned by your husband. You can also bring it to me to write it. I'll also see what your husband has taught you? "
Zhuoran nodded, then ran to the room and took his schoolbag to the old man's room. He took out the Four Treasures of the Study and wrote the "Thousand-Character Essay" seriously. The old man looked at Zhuoran's writing and couldn't help but nod! Zhuo Ran sometimes wrote irregularly, so he reminded Zhuo Ran from time to time, and soon Zhuo Ran finished the homework assigned by his teacher! The old man chuckled and said, "Your handwriting is very correct, very good! Your husband must have praised you, right? Zhuoran said proudly, "My husband always praises me and tells me that I am talented and tells me to persevere!" The old man said, "Zhuoran!" You are a good boy and a man! Do you want to help your mother do more things and protect her when you grow up? After Zhuo Ran heard what the old man said, he immediately stood up and said, "I must protect my mother!" The old man stretched out his hand and touched Zhuo Ran's forehead and said, "Grandpa will teach you a way to make you stronger and protect your mother in the future, okay?" Zhuoran nodded vigorously and said, "Okay!" "
There was a sound of horse hooves outside, and Zhuo Ran said to the old man, "Grandpa Cai is back. I don't know what to bring for me today!" I'll go see and get something delicious for you to eat! The old man said, "Go!" "Zhuoran ran to the door. Sure enough, it was Lao Cai who drove the carriage to the door. Zhuoran quickly opened all the doors so that the carriage could go directly to the yard. Lao Cai parked the carriage. When he got out of the carriage, he touched Zhuo Ran's little face and said, "Zhuoran, did you miss me? Zhuoran nodded repeatedly and said, "Think about it!" Think about it! Lao Cai chuckled and said, "You really want me to bring you some delicious food, right?" "After that, he took out a bag of snacks from the carriage and handed it to Zhuo Ran, and then he unloaded the carriage! Zhuo Ran took the bag of snacks and ran to the west side room. Lao Cai took a look, although he was a little surprised, because he knew that room had always been It was empty, and few people usually went there, but she didn't ask anything! Just then, Gao Birou came out of the kitchen and walked to him and told him about the old man's injury! Upon hearing this, Lao Cai quickly walked to the old man's room and asked as soon as he entered the room, "Brother!" Are your feet in the way? The old man heard this and said quickly, "It's okay!" It's just a twist, and it'll be fine in a few days! It's causing trouble for you! "Lao Cai said, "It's okay! You can rest assured to recuperate here, and you don’t have to worry about anything else! The old man nodded repeatedly and said, "I'm causing trouble for you!" Lao Cai said, "It's okay, no trouble!" You rest first, I'll go out and work for a while! "After saying that, he turned around and went out!
